source: TWSE MI_MARGN daily complete market report
availability: Use previous market-day report only; O/X flags are announced next-business-day conditions, not current-day fills.
missing: Missing report rows stay unknown, never infer zero or credit eligibility from absence.
feature_rule: Each day (today-prev)/(prev+1) clipped [-1,5], then full 1/5/20 market-day window mean. Utilization=today/(announced next-day limit+1) clipped [0,5]. Known O/X flags; shift all features one market day. Normalizing before rolling avoids mixing pre/post-split unit scales.
train: 2023 onwards; prior-year Dec31 cutoff; label ends by cutoff
selection: Same as-of complete feature pool; unknown future endpoints retained; no replacement or zero imputation.
